steps.expr: (() => { const svg=document.querySelector('svg'); const rg=[...svg.querySelectorAll('g')].filter(x=>{const t=x.getAttribute('transform')||''; return t.includes('rotate') && t.includes('translate(0 -9)') && x.querySelector('path');}); if(!rg.length) return JSON.stringify({ok:false,why:'no rank g'}); const tr=rg[0].getAttribute('transform'); const m=tr.match(/translate\(([\d.]+) ([\d.]+)\) rotate\(([\d.-]+)\)/); const rp={x:+m[1],y:+m[2]}; const tang=+m[3]; /* arc center/radius from template consts */ const C={x:320,y:330},R=185; const nx=(rp.x-C.x)/R, ny=(rp.y-C.y)/R; const expected={x:+(rp.x+nx*7).toFixed(1), y:+(rp.y+ny*7).toFixed(1)}; const ctm=rg[0].getCTM(); const actual={x:+(ctm.a*0+ctm.c*0+ctm.e).toFixed(1), y:+(ctm.b*0+ctm.d*0+ctm.f).toFixed(1)}; return JSON.stringify({ok:true, tang:+tang.toFixed(1), expectedGlyphCenter:expected, actualGroupOrigin:actual, delta:{x:+(actual.x-expected.x).toFixed(1), y:+(actual.y-expected.y).toFixed(1)}}); })()
